title: Meeting the Moment: Leveraging Youth Leadership
description: Institutions say they want youth involvement. But there's a difference between consulting young people and actually shifting power to them. Drawing on his experience as a Youth Sounding Board Member for the European Commission (1 of 25 selected from 4,000+ across 150 countries) and as a WEF Global Shaper, Gilberto offers a frank assessment of what real intergenerational collaboration requires — and what gets in the way.
